blocks.text: This document invites qualified {{supplier_type}} to submit a complete technical and commercial quotation for {{rfq_title}}. The selected supplier must demonstrate capable manufacturing processes, stable quality systems, adequate liquidity for a {{payment_days}}-day payment cycle, and reliable {{delivery_model}} supply.
The released drawing, approved material specification and purchase order will prevail over this document where expressly stated.
Submit one signed PDF response and one editable commercial workbook by email to the RFQ contact before the quotation deadline.
Use the section numbering and response tables in this RFQ. Clearly identify every exception, assumption and dependency in the deviation schedule.
Quote in Indian rupees. Show material, conversion, finishing, packaging, freight, tooling and taxes separately.
Provide documentary evidence requested in the bid checklist. Redacted documents may be accepted where commercially sensitive, subject to buyer review.
Direct technical and commercial questions only to the RFQ contact.

The sourcing objective is to establish a reliable, cost-competitive and quality-controlled supply arrangement for {{quantity}} units over an initial {{schedule_months}}-month period. The award may be extended or scaled subject to performance and mutual agreement; no forecast beyond the purchase order is guaranteed.
Ongoing quality control, lot traceability, change management, corrective action and capacity reporting.
Support for buyer audits, trials, cost-reduction workshops and continuous improvement.
The buyer will release the controlled drawing / specification to shortlisted suppliers under confidentiality obligations.
No material, source, process, tooling, location or sub-tier change is permitted after approval without prior written buyer authorization.
Supplier shall perform a manufacturing-feasibility review and identify technical risks in the quotation.

The supplier shall own or have securely controlled access to equipment capable of producing the item consistently at the quoted rate. All proposed outsourced processes must be disclosed with the sub-tier name, location, certification and control method.
Demonstrate capacity for {{quantity}} units over {{schedule_months}} months and at least 20 percent short-term upside without deterioration in quality or delivery.
State cycle time, planned shifts, staffing, changeover time, scrap assumption and bottleneck operation.
Identify other programmes sharing key equipment and quantify available capacity during the proposed production window.

blocks.text: Maintain all required environmental consents and manage hazardous waste through authorised handlers.
Maintain risk assessments, machine guarding, PPE, training and incident reporting.
Prohibit child labour, forced labour, harassment and discrimination; maintain a worker grievance mechanism.
Maintain controls against bribery, fraud and conflicts of interest.

Restrict drawings, specifications and pricing to authorised personnel. Submit a site business-continuity plan covering power failure, equipment breakdown, labour disruption and logistics interruption, with insurance coverage (required: {{continuity}}).
Mandatory requirements and unacceptable risk may override aggregate score. The buyer may conduct clarification meetings, plant audits, sample trials and financial diligence.
This RFQ is an invitation to quote and does not constitute a purchase order or obligation to award business.
The buyer may accept or reject any response, negotiate with one or more suppliers, modify or cancel the RFQ, or divide the award.
No deviation is effective unless expressly accepted in the purchase order.
The supplier shall comply with applicable Indian laws and regulatory requirements.
Proposed subcontracting requires disclosure and does not relieve the supplier of responsibility for quality, delivery, compliance or confidentiality.
